attributes.name: search submit control
attributes.definition: How the search field's submit affordance is presented: an icon within the field versus a labeled button.

values.definition: A magnifier or similar icon marks the field with no text button.
A button labeled with text (e.g. 'Search') is attached to or inside the field.
No visible submit control or no search field.

attributes.name: search field shape
attributes.definition: The outline shape of the search input container.

values.definition: Any other treatment or not present.

attributes.name: search field fill
attributes.definition: Background treatment of the search input.

values.definition: Plain white or light solid fill.
No fill, defined by a border only.
